register: Electron audit findings reviewed and accepted
note: QGD-SEC-0014. A finding is accepted only when its check, its file and the fingerprint of the reviewed line all match. Matching the check and file alone would wave through a new switch or a second preload under a rationale written for different code. A finding not listed fails make verify; an entry the tool no longer reports fails it too, so the list cannot outlive what it explains. The sample is a hash of the compiled line, normalised for whitespace: reformatting is not a new review, a different statement is.

accepted.reason: The policy is default-src 'none' with 'self' allowed only for the one stylesheet and the one script this application ships. The check objects to 'self' in principle; the only stricter setting is to inline them, which the same policy forbids and which is worse. connection-capture proves the policy holds at runtime: the renderer reaches nothing by any of seven routes.

The switches disable background networking, component update, domain reliability, sync, pings, and three features. Every one of them removes something the application would otherwise do; none widens what it can reach.

A preload is the architecture: it is how the sandboxed renderer reaches the broker without Node. QGD-SEC-0007 constrains what it may expose to named functions only, and src/preload.cts exposes exactly one. The check asks for review, and this is the review.
